author: MysticPower
quote:
I've played every 3D GTA game at their release since GTA III, through my entire life. Sadly this is the weakest launch a GTA game ever had. The only GTA game that can't revolutionize gaming industry. The strongest point it has is its graphics of course but I don't even think it is as insane as people make it out to be. As of 2026 we have seen so much games with photo realistic visuals. It is hard to impress nowadays. However not many game can serve good graphics with large open map together, that is what GTA can do, usually. There are some really fun missions and interesting mechanics but these are kinda rare moments. Sadly games positive point don't go far from there that much.

Lets point out few more positive points before heading into to negatives since it will be much longer. Diverse and lively NPCs? Sure it delivers. A lot of interaction with the world and immersion? One of the best! Decent car handling you may ask? Better than the most. Well then you will naturally ask isn't these things would make it the best game ever already? Almost, sadly not quite. Let me elaborate. All of these stuff amazing only when paired with good story, interesting characters and fun combat. It is like cooking up a great soup but you missed the salt entirely. No matter how well you made everything about your soup if it lacks salt and important spices it will taste bland, foul even.

Now let me list the greatest sins of this game. First of all, the story. I don't want to spoil anything but I will keep in simple and short. Takes way too long to develop, very boring and tedious start and worst of all the ending... I have seen worse many times but in the end I am not happy. When it comes to the characters I am fan of Lucia she is full of life has interesting personality and fun. However Jason is exact opposite. Most dull, uninteresting, passive and boring character ever. Even the voice acting is horrid, sorry but not sorry. The combat usually feels awkward because of the controller and some other reason that I will elaborate later. The freedom this release lacking it the most compared to every other GTA game. Not just because of realism or for the sake of the story or even because of technical limitations. No, it just lacks freedom everywhere because developers are trying to teach player how to be a good guy in a game about crime, which is insane. How about the bugs you may ask, well there are some sure but not really game breaking. Compared to most AAA games released recently this is one of most stable release yet. The physics need some fixes and adjustment the most but I think Rockstar can handle it in a short time. The only thing left is the elephant in the room. The performance... And the 30 fps limit. It is bad, period. I understand its reasons. They wanted make the game with ray tracing mostly. They wanted to deliver the best visuals. They wanted make the game for the console. I understand all. But 30 fps is not acceptable no matter what! If they can't deliver 60 fps stable in 2026 then they should have downgraded the graphics or crowd density or draw distance. 30 fps have no excuse! Combat is already annoying because it is not easy to aim with the controller event with aim assist and 30 FPS does not help at all. I understand the hardware limitations too. Well this game is clearly not made for consoles in mind. In that case they should have released it together with the PC version. I get that they might have done it strategically as business decision but it is not my concern. I am not happy with their decision only that matters to me. I mean no matter how beautiful the game is, my eyes are literally hurting while playing it. Literally headache inducing ,nauseating experience. 4K textures, ray tracing reflections and, shadows are meaningless when I am mostly looking into a pixel soup.

In order to summarize everything, all I can say is this game has a lot of potential but everything ruined because of simple stuff. They got all unnecessary stuff right and botched the core stuff mostly. If my review sounds like a haters review to you then all I can say is I just wanted this game to succeed, really did. My anger just comes from the disappointment.
